in_sanskrit.name: Reshma
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Soft, tender, gentle
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Reshma एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Reshma means soft, tender, gentle. It is a name that evokes a sense of warmth and nurturing. It is often used for girls born under the influence of the Moon, and is associated with the natural world and the cycles of life.

in_hindi.long_meaning: Born in the night and an essential part of a significant group

in_tamil.name: ரேஷ்மா
in_tamil.long_meaning: Those who come from the clan of the temple priest
